items.title: Cencora to Report Q3 Earnings: Is a Beat Likely for the Stock?
items.summary: COR's Q3 results could reflect specialty pharma strength, oncology expansion and margin gains, even as pricing dynamics and GLP-1 trends pressure revenues.

items.title: Solventum to Report Q2 Earnings: What's in Store for the Stock?
items.summary: SOLV's Q2 results are likely to benefit from segment strength, Acera gains and cost savings, offset by tariffs and ERP-related sales timing shifts.

items.title: Thermo Fisher Raises 2026 Outlook After Strong Second-Quarter Results
items.summary: TMO lifted its 2026 outlook after Q2 topped estimates, driven by stronger demand, acquisitions and margin gains. Can the momentum continue?

items.title: How Thermo Fisher Is Riding Bioproduction and AI-Led Growth Trends
items.summary: TMO is expanding bioproduction, AI tools and clinical data capabilities, but execution will be key as competition intensifies.

items.title: Stryker (SYK) Q2 Earnings and Revenues Beat Estimates
items.summary: Stryker (SYK) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +6.65% and +0.48%, respectively, for the quarter ended June 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

items.title: Avantor Stock Surged Because One Segment Stopped Shrinking
items.summary: Organic revenue still fell, yet a segment returning to growth and a raised outlook were enough to reprice the stock in a single session.

items.title: Revvity to Report Q2 Earnings: What's in Store for the Stock?
items.summary: RVTY heads into Q2 earnings with improving Life Sciences demand and resilient Diagnostics. Can stronger margins offset lingering headwinds?

items.title: Philips Q2 Earnings and Revenues Increase Year over Year, Shares Down
items.summary: PHG lifts its 2026 profit and free cash flow outlook after Q2 earnings increase on higher sales, productivity gains and a U.S. tariff refund benefit.
